verdict.rationale: The first-party docs in the pack never document a training opt-out, a data-usage control, or a retention policy for Grok Build. Community posts mention an in-product 'Improve the model' toggle, but they report it has no effect on what is uploaded, and only the enterprise plan is said to offer ZDR. Because those reports come from a single tier, they cannot establish a dispute. The config flags users mention (disable_codebase_upload, telemetry off) control upload and telemetry, which is adjacent to the story and is not a documented training opt-out.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
